plan.initialization_scope: each architecture starts from its completed seed41 64k/4096 CE checkpoint; both objectives and both new seeds share that architecture's exact initial weights
plan.training: full used language backbone and tied input embeddings; DUMA matching readout; vision frozen; fresh FP32-master AdamW
plan.objective_ce: mean gold CE across the exact same 16 cases, including the same four pairs
plan.objective_pair: same CE + .25 * mean softplus(1 - [(za[ya]-za[yb])-(zb[ya]-zb[yb])]) across four flip pairs
plan.augmentation: same option permutation and code assignment within each pair; exactly matched cached examples across all four arms per seed

data.vitaminc_filter: official real revisions only, no FEVER examples or synthetic revisions
data.canonicalization: generic instruction and equivalent choice rendering/order; evidence, question/claim and gold label unchanged
data.retention_context_filter: structured premise/passage/evidence/background/sentence contexts >=80 chars; same normalization as cross-corpus audit; plain states fingerprinted in full; <=64 distinct document groups/source
data.edit_filter: exactly one contiguous lexical edit region, <=16 changed regex tokens, token similarity >=.8; evidence and existing gold otherwise unchanged

plan.primary: final flip-pair both-correct interaction (dual_pair-dual_ce)-(native_pair-native_ce), mean over the two paired seeds
plan.secondary: within-architecture paired-loss effects; dual_pair-native_pair; invariant both-correct; fresh general source-macro accuracy and original-correct preservation
plan.final_testing: unused document pairs and general retention evaluated only after all eight fixed-step models are frozen; no checkpoint selection or accuracy early stop
plan.mechanism_ablation: DUMA passage inputs to matching zeroed after unchanged encoder; active/off use the exact same entire test batches; diagnostic does not remove evidence already in encoder states
plan.advance: only exploratory candidate: adjusted interaction interval above0, interaction positive in both seeds, and observed dual_pair-native_pair general macro and invariant both-correct >=-.005; point guards are not statistical noninferiority; no automatic long training
plan.bootstrap: 2000 document-cluster draws within each source, paired across all four conditions and both seeds; Bonferroni four comparisons; conditional on these two seeds
plan.optimizer: BF16 forward/backward, FP32-master AdamW betas(.9,.95), WD.01, global clip1; linear warmup then cosine to10%
limits: specialized mechanism test on two evidence-change tasks, not general architectural superiority
two seeds do not characterize population training variance
seeds41/73 vary new training only; architecture initial checkpoints both use old seed41
CONDAQA documents are original passages, not entire Wikipedia articles
unknown original pretraining and semantic paraphrases cannot be exhaustively excluded
